Frequently Asked Questions — WhatsApp Marriage Biodata Maker

Common questions about creating, customizing, and downloading your WhatsApp Marriage Biodata Maker in PDF, Word (.docx), and HD PNG formats.

How does the "WhatsApp" share button format my biodata?

Clicking "WhatsApp" compiles all your visible sections and fields into a clean, readable WhatsApp message with bold headings (e.g., *Personal Details*, *Education & Career*) and opens WhatsApp so you can send it along with your downloaded PDF or PNG.

Can I hide my annual income or house address before sharing on a WhatsApp group?

Yes! Click the eye icon (👁) next to any field in the editor to hide it from the A4 sheet, PDF, PNG, and WhatsApp summary without deleting your typed text.

Should I send a PNG image or a PDF on WhatsApp?

We recommend downloading both: send the HD PNG so relatives see an instant visual preview in chat, and attach the A4 PDF for high-resolution zooming and printing.

Does the WhatsApp text summary include any promotional spam?

No. It generates a clean, respectful matrimonial profile summary formatted for family sharing.
